# Truss — resumable, verifiable AI-agent execution

> Truss is a Rust agent harness with task contracts, durable replay, harness-run checks, and signed execution records. Explore the code, architecture, and limits.

## Canonical sources

- [Project overview](https://controlstackai.github.io/truss/): scope, status, and getting started.
- [Repository](https://github.com/ControlStackAI/truss): current implementation and README.
